questions.question: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.

options.A: Each of the players has a kit.
options.B: Each of the players have a kit.
options.C: Each of the player has a kit.

questions.explanation: 'Each of' takes a singular verb: has.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of 'diligent'.
questions.explanation: Diligent means careful and hard-working.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'scarce'.
questions.explanation: Scarce means limited; abundant means plentiful.

questions.question: The committee will look ___ the matter and submit a report.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb is 'look into', meaning investigate.

questions.question: Change to passive voice: 'The officer approved the file.'

options.A: The file was approved by the officer.
options.B: The file is approved by the officer.
options.C: The officer was approved by the file.

questions.explanation: Simple past active changes to 'was/were + past participle'.

questions.question: Choose the indirect speech: He said, 'I am ready.'

options.A: He said that I am ready.
options.B: He says that he was ready.
options.D: He said that he was ready.

questions.explanation: In reported speech, 'am' changes to 'was' when the reporting verb is past.

questions.question: The idiom 'to hit the nail on the head' means:

options.C: To say exactly the right thing

questions.explanation: The idiom means to identify or say something accurately.

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is accommodation.

questions.question: Select the best word: Good preparation reduces exam-day ___.
questions.explanation: The sentence needs a word meaning nervousness.

questions.question: Improve the phrase: 'No sooner the bell rang than the students left.'

options.A: No sooner did the bell ring than the students left.
options.B: No sooner bell rang than students left.
options.C: No sooner the bell rings than left.
options.D: No sooner did the bell rang than students left.

questions.explanation: 'No sooner' takes inversion with did + base verb.

questions.question: Choose the best order: P. he checked the map Q. before moving ahead R. the cadet halted S. near the ridge
questions.explanation: The natural sequence is: the cadet halted near the ridge, checked the map, before moving ahead.

questions.question: A passage says that discipline turns courage into dependable action. Which statement best captures the idea?

options.C: Courage becomes useful when guided by discipline.

questions.explanation: The sentence links discipline with reliable courage.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: The troops advanced ___ the bridge at dawn.
questions.explanation: Towards shows movement in the direction of a place.

questions.question: A person who studies weather conditions is called a:
questions.explanation: Meteorology is the study of weather and atmosphere.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'hostile'.
questions.explanation: Hostile means unfriendly or antagonistic.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of 'resolute'.
questions.explanation: Resolute means firm and determined.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.

options.A: Neither of the answers are correct.
options.D: Neither of the answers is correct.

questions.explanation: Neither takes a singular verb in this construction.

questions.question: Improve the underlined idea: 'He is senior than me.'

options.D: He is more senior than me.

questions.explanation: Senior is followed by 'to'.

questions.question: Select the best word: A good leader remains calm under ___.
questions.explanation: The phrase is 'under pressure'.

questions.question: Change the voice: 'The team completed the mission.'

options.B: The mission was completed by the team.
options.C: The mission is completed by the team.
options.D: The team was completed by the mission.

questions.explanation: Simple past passive uses was/were + past participle.

questions.question: The Fundamental Rights in the Constitution of India are mainly contained in which Part?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Rights are listed in Part III of the Constitution.

questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Plassey took place in 1757.

questions.question: Which is the largest gland in the human body?
questions.explanation: The liver is the largest gland in the human body.

questions.question: Which institution is the central bank of India?
questions.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India is India's central bank.

questions.question: The Finance Commission is constituted under which Article of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article 280 provides for the Finance Commission.

questions.question: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment is related to:
questions.explanation: The 73rd Amendment gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions.

questions.question: Hemoglobin contains which metal?
questions.explanation: Hemoglobin contains iron, which helps transport oxygen.

questions.question: The Sundarbans delta is mainly formed by which river system?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans is part of the Ganga-Brahmaputra delta.

questions.question: Sattriya is a classical dance form associated with which state?
questions.explanation: Sattriya originated in Assam.

questions.question: The SI unit of pressure is:
questions.explanation: Pressure is measured in pascal.

questions.question: GST was introduced in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect in India on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in:
questions.explanation: The massacre took place on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: Kharif crops are generally sown during which season in India?
questions.explanation: Kharif crops are sown with the onset of monsoon.

questions.question: Photosynthesis releases which gas?
questions.explanation: Plants release oxygen during photosynthesis.

questions.question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: One-rupee currency notes in India are signed by:
questions.explanation: One-rupee notes are issued by the Government of India and signed by the Finance Secretary.

questions.question: The Hornbill Festival is celebrated in:
questions.explanation: Hornbill Festival is a major cultural festival of Nagaland.

questions.question: The pH value of a neutral solution at 25 C is:
questions.explanation: A neutral solution has pH 7 at 25 C.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.explanation: It passes through eight Indian states.

questions.question: The slogan 'Do or Die' is associated with which movement?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi gave the 'Do or Die' call during the Quit India Movement.

questions.question: For exam preparation, the most reliable source for a government recruitment date is usually:
questions.explanation: Official notifications are the primary source.

questions.question: The Olympic Games are held every:
questions.explanation: Summer Olympics are normally held every four years.

questions.question: The Bharat Ratna is:
questions.explanation: Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian honour in India.

questions.question: The United Nations was established after:
questions.explanation: The UN was founded in 1945 after World War II.

questions.question: ISRO is primarily associated with:
questions.explanation: ISRO is India's space agency.

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys an article for Rs. 420 and sells it at a profit of 15%. What is the selling price?
questions.explanation: Selling price = CP x (100 + profit%)/100 = 420 x 115/100 = 483.

questions.question: Find the simple interest on Rs. 3500 at 8% per annum for 2 years.
questions.explanation: Simple interest = P x R x T / 100.

questions.question: A can complete a work in 21 days and B can complete it in 42 days. Working together, they complete it in how many days?
questions.explanation: Combined work per day = 1/21 + 1/42. Time = ab/(a+b) = 14 days.

questions.question: A train of length 220 m crosses a pole at 54 km/h. How many seconds does it take?
questions.explanation: Convert speed to m/s by multiplying by 5/18, then time = distance/speed.

questions.question: The average score of 5 candidates is 33. If one more candidate scoring 50 joins them, what is the new average?
questions.explanation: New average = (old total + new score)/(number of candidates + 1).

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 900 is divided in the ratio 2:5. What is the smaller share?
questions.explanation: Smaller share = total x smaller ratio part / sum of ratio parts.

questions.question: What is 21% of 320?
questions.explanation: Percentage value = number x percentage / 100.

questions.question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 6500 at 12% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually.
questions.explanation: Amount = P(1 + r/100)^2. Compound interest = amount - principal.

questions.question: The marked price of a bag is Rs. 1450. After a discount of 15%, what is the selling price?
questions.explanation: Selling price after discount = marked price x (100 - discount%)/100.

questions.question: The side of a square is 10 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area of a square = side x side.

questions.question: A person walks 6 km north, turns right and walks 8 km, then turns right and walks 6 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: The north and south movements cancel out; only 8 km east remains.

questions.question: Statements: All books are papers. Some papers are files. Conclusions: I. Some files are books. II. Some papers are books. Which conclusion follows?
questions.explanation: All books are papers, so some papers are books. No definite relation between files and books is established.
